Early Access Notice
Nexus Launcher is currently in Early Access.
This software is actively under development and may contain bugs, incomplete features, performance issues, or unexpected behavior. Launcher detection, game discovery, artwork retrieval, and game launching functionality may not work correctly for all supported platforms or titles.
Features, user interface elements, and functionality are subject to change without notice as development continues. Data, settings, and launcher configurations may be reset, modified, or become incompatible between versions.
By using Nexus Launcher, you acknowledge that this is a pre-release product and should not be relied upon as your sole game management solution. Feedback, bug reports, and feature suggestions are appreciated and help improve the software.
Thank you for helping test and shape Nexus Launcher.
